baselines.comparison_note: Per Codex outline pitfall: a 'lens captures motif' verdict requires the lens's coverage_score to exceed both the majority-label baseline (always-predict-most-common) and the substrate-only baseline (predict by world_family alone). If lens coverage is at or below either baseline, the lens is not contributing additional discrimination beyond what's available from substrate identity.
